_note: Measured evidence for the 500 -> 10,000 -> full-run scaling steps, copied from the run log (work/store.sqlite runs and calls tables) and the global spend ledger (work/ledger.sqlite) on 2026-10-17. Costs are the recorded bills at the rates in effect (provider usage x rates.csv), not recomputed from editable rates. Token counts are provider-reported. The full-run call log is grading/calls.jsonl.gz.

runs.status: completed (resumed: 0 new Jev calls; in-flight batch collected)

steps.failed_call_note: Two memo attempts rejected by the validator (fixed: cited IDs derived from the text; 'revenue'/'churn' allowed in Limits).
steps.decision: Fixes before scaling: fallback no longer relabels checkpointed IDs on resume; verification reserves its random sample before flagged cases; memo validator corrected. Jev measured 354.8 billed tokens per review against 360 estimated, so the cost model held.

projection_after_step.note: Remaining work $7.70 base (Jev $7.24 for 475,741 new texts, verify $0.19, fallback $0.25, group and memo $0.01); conservative adds 10% retries and the full verification cap.

steps.decision: Issue taxonomy v2 adopted (deterministic; catch-all share 62% -> 39% on the same data). Projection within the $10 cap in both scenarios, so the full run was started with unchanged concurrency.

project_spend.source: work/ledger.sqlite (all settled reservations + 2 open reservations from an aborted pilot counted at their worst case); includes the 2026-10-18 real-model injection test (run synthetic_injection-20261018T012349Z, <$0.01)

console_usd.note: Screenshots taken 2026-10-17, before the injection test, matched the ledger to the cent: TypeSafe $7.29 and Anthropic $0.49. The 2026-10-18 injection test then added less than $0.01, moving Anthropic to $0.50.

controls.budget: Project cap $10 in the shared ledger; run caps --budget 9.5 (full run) and 0.5 (group/memo rerun). Each request reserves its worst-case cost before dispatch; work stops when spent + reserved + next reservation would exceed a cap.
controls.concurrency: 1 worker. Jev: 20 reviews per request, up to 8 requests in flight, shared limiters of 10 requests/s and 80,000 tokens/s (provider limits 80/s and 100k tokens/s). Claude: Batch API jobs of at most 500 requests x 50 reviews.
controls.fallback_limit: At most 1% of distinct texts (4,841), chosen from verifier disagreements, never every failure.
controls.verification: 2% stratified random sample (9,681 texts) reserved first, then flagged cases up to a 5% cap: 24,203 texts verified.
controls.retries: Jev: up to 3 attempts per text, failed requests split into smaller ones. 429/5xx/network errors retried with backoff and logged as 'transient', never counted as review failures. 401/403/404 stop the run without marking reviews failed.
controls.recovery: Interrupted after 2,000 Jev requests (196,460 completed IDs in grading/checkpoint_before.json); the resume made no enrichment call for those IDs and ended with 660,609 completed (grading/checkpoint_after.json). In-flight Claude batches are collected on restart, not resubmitted.
controls.dashboard_reconciliation: Reconciled on 2026-10-17 against the provider consoles (screenshots in receipts/), before the injection test: TypeSafe $7.29 and Anthropic $0.49, matching the ledger to the cent (the Anthropic figure includes <$0.01 counted at worst case for two uncollected pilot batches). The 2026-10-18 injection test then added <$0.01.
